summary: First Community Bankshares filed an 8-K on April 28, 2026, announcing first quarter 2026 earnings and a quarterly cash dividend of $0.31 per common share, payable May 29, 2026, to shareholders of record May 15, 2026. The filing contains routine results of operations and financial condition (Item 2.02) and an other events item (Item 8.01) for the dividend declaration. No M&A, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, restructuring, or other special situation activity is disclosed. The filing is a standard earnings and dividend release, not a special situation.
